title: MCP Tasks
description: The official extension for long-running work, where a server returns a durable task handle instead of blocking and the client polls for the outcome.
question: Can the agent start work that outlives the request that began it?
why: Tasks moved out of the core protocol into an official extension in this revision, and the API was redesigned around polling. Without it, any operation longer than a request timeout has to be faked with a handle passed through tool arguments.
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

notes.mastra: Mastra 2.2.0: the client declares no Tasks extension (`io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks`) and calls a task-capable tool without asking for a task, so it never polls for one.
notes.openai-agents: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.23.1: the client declares no Tasks extension (`io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks`) and calls a task-capable tool without asking for a task, so it never polls for one.
notes.pydantic-ai: Pydantic AI 2.54.0: the client declares no Tasks extension (`io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks`) and calls a task-capable tool without asking for a task, so it never polls for one.
notes.strands: Strands Agents 1.59.0: The Tasks extension is opt-in through `MCPClient(tasks_config=...)`. With the defaults an agent gets, the client declares no Tasks extension and calls a task-capable tool without task augmentation.
notes.vercel_ai: Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/mcp 2.0.73): the client declares no Tasks extension and calls `task_capable` without task augmentation. The fixture answers synchronously.
notes.openai_agents_js: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) 0.20.0: the client declares no Tasks extension and calls a task-capable tool with a plain `tools/call`; a tool that requires tasks is refused by the SDK.
notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: the fastmcp `Client` `MCPTools` builds declares no Tasks extension and calls task-capable tools synchronously, without task augmentation.
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: the caller's client declares no Tasks extension, and the `Tool` calls `task_capable` synchronously with no task augmentation.
notes.langchain_js: LangChain.js (@langchain/mcp-adapters 2.0.1): the client declares no Tasks extension, and the adapter calls the task-capable tool without task augmentation.
notes.copilot_sdk: GitHub Copilot SDK 1.0.19 (Copilot runtime 1.0.95): no Tasks extension is declared, so `task_capable` was called without task augmentation (`task_requested=False`).
notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: `DefaultMcpClient` declares no Tasks extension and calls a task-capable tool without task augmentation.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): the client declares no Tasks extension, and `mcpTool.Run` sends `tools/call` with no task augmentation.
notes.ms_agent_framework_dotnet: Microsoft Agent Framework (.NET) 1.24.0 (ModelContextProtocol 2.2.0): no Tasks extension is declared, so `task_capable` was called without task augmentation.
